Fixture.Description: Synthetic 8-host / 2-shared-library fixture; no private adopter data.

BuildPreparation.Description: The synthetic fixture build and one --ensure-built receipt-preparation invocation completed before timed batches. Every measured process used --use-prepared-receipts and did not restore or build.

Scenarios.Description: One independent strict validation process using prepared receipts
Two independent strict processes using prepared receipts over one unchanged build
Four independent strict processes using prepared receipts over one unchanged build
Two independent strict processes using prepared receipts dispatched together
Four independent strict processes using prepared receipts dispatched together

Attribution.Conclusion: In the 1-process prepared-receipt scenario, build_state_preflight verification is 81.0ms of 734.0ms inner median (11.0% median per-sample share). The separate --ensure-built priming measurement contains restore/build and receipt preparation and is not included in timed scenario samples. No version regression is proven by this synthetic current-tree run.
Attribution.Limitation: The one-time --ensure-built restore/build and receipt preparation are recorded separately from measured --use-prepared-receipts validation. Outer process timing does not measure the caller's container or CI runner; comparable-version consumer-side timestamps are still required to prove a regression.

Routing.Decision: Feed the reusable large-multi-host process-count shape and per-process profile counters into the canonical benchmark foundation; do not create a competing framework.
Prepared-analysis reuse remains the owner for cross-process preparation; this harness measures duplication but does not implement reuse.
No selector/layer, real-MSBuild cache-eligibility, or changed-project advisory conclusion is asserted by this matrix.

MeasurementBoundary: The fixture build and one --ensure-built receipt-preparation invocation are reported separately. Measured runs use --use-prepared-receipts, so their build_state_preflight phases measure prepared-receipt verification without restore or graph build. The harness measures local startup/process and ArchLinterNet boundaries; container, scheduler, and CI-runner time require caller-side instrumentation.
